differences.native: LeetCode calls guessNumber(n) and supplies the global guess(num) oracle for its hidden value.
differences.app: solve(n, pick) receives the authored hidden value explicitly and defines guess(num) with the same three-way result.
differences.rationale: The offline runner must receive the otherwise hidden value as deterministic case data. After this environment adapter, both forms execute the same binary-search statements, oracle calls, control flow, and logarithmic query complexity.
